content: जन्य {%a.%} [जन् कर्तरि यत्] .²1 To be born or produced. .²2 Born, produced. .²3 (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) Born from, occasioned by. .²4 Belonging to a race or family .²5 Vulgar, common. .²6 National. .²7 Relating to, or fit for men. .{@-न्यः@} .²1 A father. .²2 A friend, attendant or relative of a bridegroom; <ls>Māl. 6. 2</ls>. .²3 A common man. .²4 A report, rumour. .{@-न्या@} .²1 Motherʼs friend, .²2 The relation of a bride, a brideʼs maid; याहीति जन्यामवदत् कुमारी <ls>R. 6. 30</ls>. .²3 Pleasure, happiness. .²4 Affection. .²5 a market. .²6 The world; जन्या तु मातृसख्यां च मदे हट्टे जनेऽपि च . लोके जन्तौ … <ls>Nm.</ls> .{@-न्यम्@} .²1 Birth, production, creation. .²2 That which is born or created, a created thing, an effect (<ab>opp.</ab> जनक) जन्यानां जनकः कालः <ls>Bhāṣā P. 45</ls>; जनकस्य स्वभावो हि जन्ये तिष्ठति निश्चितम् <ls>Śabdak.</ls> .²3 The body; तुष्टाव जन्यं विसृजञ्जनार्दनम् <ls>Bhāg. 1. 9. 31</ls>. .²4 A portent occurring at birth. .²5 A market, a fair. .²6 War, battle; तत्र जन्यं रघोर्घोरं पर्वतीयैर्गणरभूत् <ls>R. 4. 77</ls>; चारुणा रमते जन्ये कोऽभीतो रसिताशिनि <ls>Ki. 15. 23</ls>. .²7 Censure, abuse. .²8 A community, nation. .²9 People. .²10 Report, rumour.
